title: Elara and the Secret Attic Library
logline: A curious girl named Elara discovers a silent clockwork owl that leads her on a magical quest to find a floating key, unlocking a magnificent secret attic library filled with endless stories.

character_bible.name: Elara
character_bible.visual_appearance: Small, curious girl with bright emerald green eyes, long wavy strawberry blonde hair tied neatly with a sky-blue ribbon, fair skin.
character_bible.signature_clothing: A soft lavender dress with short puff sleeves, white ruffled trim at the collar, and small golden buttons down the front.

scenes.title: The Dusty Discovery
scenes.narrative_text: Elara tip-toed into the dusty old attic. Sunbeams danced through a tiny window, revealing forgotten treasures. Among them, a peculiar, silent owl sat on a high shelf, its gears glinting softly. It looked like it was waiting for something.

scenes.title: The Clockwork Owl's Secret
scenes.narrative_text: Elara carefully reached for the Clockwork Owl. Its bronze feathers felt cool. A tiny keyhole glimmered on its chest, but no key was in sight. Then, a whispered riddle floated on the breeze: "To wake the wise, find what floats and flies."

scenes.title: Chasing the Floating Key
scenes.narrative_text: Elara looked around. High above, near the window, a shimmering Floating Key danced! It glittered like a tiny star, zipping just out of reach. Elara giggled, stacking old books to create a wobbly tower, stretching her hand towards the magical key.

scenes.title: The Secret Attic Library Revealed
scenes.narrative_text: With a triumphant grin, Elara inserted the Floating Key into the Clockwork Owl's chest. Click! Whirr! The owl's eyes glowed, and it hooted softly. Slowly, a hidden wall creaked open, revealing the most magnificent Secret Attic Library imaginable, filled with ancient scrolls and sparkling dust.

scenes.title: A World of Wonder
scenes.narrative_text: Elara stepped into the Secret Attic Library, her eyes wide with wonder. The Clockwork Owl perched on her shoulder, a new friend. Every book seemed to whisper a story, inviting her to explore. This cozy library was a treasure trove of endless adventures, waiting to be read.
